lines.text: Heman the Ezrahite cries out to the LORD day and night and asks Him to incline His ear.
Heman's life draws near to Sheol, and he says the LORD has laid him in the lowest Pit.
Heman says the LORD's clouds have submerged him and that the LORD has made him repulsive to his friends.
Heman calls to the LORD daily and spreads out his hands, then asks about His faithfulness in Abaddon.
Heman says he has been afflicted for seven years, and the LORD's terrors enclose him like water on every side.
